introduction: Ohio SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries using an Ohio Direction EBT card. County JFS determines the household’s benefit.
description: Ohio SNAP helps eligible households buy groceries using an Ohio Direction EBT card. County JFS determines the household’s benefit.

sections.who: The county reviews household membership, income, allowable expenses and applicable eligibility rules. Explain who lives together and normally buys and prepares food together.
sections.get: The benefit amount depends on household circumstances. SNAP covers eligible food, rather than medicine, alcohol or household supplies.
sections.docs:
• Household identity and income records.
  • Housing and other expenses requested for the calculation.
  • Requested status and Social Security information.
sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Start at Ohio Benefits or contact your county JFS.

  2. Complete intake

    Attend the interview and return any additional checklist items. Tell the worker if you have little income or food and need urgent screening.

  3. Keep the decision

    Read the approval or denial notice and any card instructions.
sections.after: Complete required interim reports and renewal interviews. Check current EBT security settings before an online or out-of-state purchase.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using County SNAP overview; Food and cash intake. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
